Subject: Tier reshuffle & feature ask

Hi Olga / Marcus —

Quick note from the product team after our pilot metrics came back: we like Redwood’s latency and the KV-cache savings, but the way features are gated across tiers is making our procurement math hard. Two asks we wanted to float:

1) Could you move per-request prefix caching (the small prefix cache service) from Pro -> Standard? We’d take on a modest commitment to make that feasible.
2) We need the realtime routing policy (multi-region pref) as an add-on rather than being Pro-only — our deployment footprint is mostly single-region for now.

If we can rearrange those two items and discuss a commensurate price adjustment (we’re looking at a 12–18 month committed consumption plan), we can accelerate signature.

Attached is a short note that explains our desired configuration and estimated token volume. Happy to jump on a call this week.

Thanks —
Samantha Ibarra
Director of Platform Partnerships
BrightTech Labs

Folks — forwarding BrightTech’s ask. High level context: pilot very healthy, but they want two features moved down a tier / or converted to paid add-ons so their procurement math fits existing budget bands.

Questions:
- Technical: Is per-request prefix caching safe to ship to Standard with their estimated token volumes (see attachment)? Any stability or SLO concerns?
- Commercial: If we convert realtime routing to an add-on with X regional price, what sort of delta do we expect on ACV for a 12–18 month commit?

I’ve flagged this as time-sensitive — they indicated willingness to sign if we land a configuration and discount that fits.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tier reshuffle & feature ask (BrightTech) — options matrix attached

Summary of options (see attached redwood-option-matrix-0302.xlsx):

Option A — Minimal:
- Keep features as-is. Offer 10% commit discount on 12 months.
- Provide a one-time credit for migration support.
Pros: No SKU changes, simplest to implement.
Cons: Customer still pays Pro price for realtime routing.

Option B — Repackage:
- Move prefix caching to Standard for customers under 1B tokens/month (BrightTech qualifies).
- Reprice realtime routing as a per-region add-on ($0.015 per 1k tokens / region).
- Offer 12-month commit at 12% discount + volume tiers.
Pros: Aligns with customer ask, little runtime risk if we gate to volumes.
Cons: Requires catalog change and billing SKU update.

Option C — Hybrid with incentive:
- Same as B, but include 15% commit discount and a 3-month trial of routing for free (up to 200M tokens across all regions).
- Add clause: routing reverts to Pro-only if cross-region token baseline exceeds threshold.
Pros: Most likely to close; flexible.
Cons: Short-term revenue give.

Technical note: from infra perspective, moving prefix caching down is fine provided we enable a conservative cache size and autoscale limits — Rishi can comment on limits.

Next steps: Monica, can you model ACV deltas for each option (with projected year-1 consumption)? If legal approves the hybrid term we can offer Option C as a signed play.

—Marcus
Product-led Sales

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tier reshuffle & feature ask (BrightTech) — pricing scenarios

Samantha — thanks for sending the note. Quick take from pricing & GTM:

We ran three scenarios (attached summary):
- Scenario 1 (Conservative): Offer Option B with 12% commit discount. Estimated ACV: $410k year-1.
- Scenario 2 (Balanced): Option C with 15% commit discount + trial. Estimated ACV: $475k year-1 — highest chance to close in Q1.
- Scenario 3 (Aggressive): Move both features to Standard with no routing add-on and give 18% discount for a 24-month commit. Estimated ACV: $350k year-1 but high revenue risk long-term.

Our recommendation: Scenario 2 (Option C). The trial gives them runway to evaluate routing while the commit protects our economics. If you confirm the trial cap (200M tokens across regions), we’ll draft a short term-sheet and legal-friendly clause that re-evaluates SKU placement at renewal.

If BrightTech signs for 12 months at the Scenario 2 economics, we can offer a signed discount of 15% (non-stacking with other promos), and include a one-time migration credit of $8k.

—Monica
Sr. Customer Success / Pricing Operations
